Automate LinkedIn content creation
The author used Comet to automate their LinkedIn content workflow and reports 5 unexpected Gumroad sales.
Done with
PC
Perplexity Comet
What they did
The author, a Perplexity Pro user with early access to the Comet browser and assistant, installed it in place of Chrome. They tried it on their LinkedIn content creation first, and Comet's assistant produced a LinkedIn post. The readable part of the article gives no prompts, steps or review process.
How it went
The author says the post led to 5 unexpected sales of their Gumroad product. The visible text doesn't show how the sales were tracked or how much of the workflow was actually automated.
Worth knowing
